name: The Gambia
description: The Gambia from the river kingdoms and the slave trade to a British colony, independence in 1965, Jammeh's rule and democracy since 2017.

checkpoints.name: River kingdoms
checkpoints.note: The stone circles were raised over centuries. Kingdoms of Mali's world lined the river, and Europeans came for gold and slaves.

checkpoints.name: British Gambia
checkpoints.note: Britain founded Bathurst in 1816 and ruled the river as a colony.

checkpoints.name: Independent Gambia
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1965. Jammeh ruled from 1994 to 2017, when he lost an election and was forced out.
